about: One Forge entry per configuration (host 2026-11-23 on the Falcons: 'consolidating them to those 4 would probably be the best move. and then their fast versions'). Project Reclaimer offers every model variant of a Forge object as its own entry, so 3 Falcon vehicles x 4 variants made 12. split_variants.py makes each new vehicle a copy of 'from' whose own model copy holds only 'variant', named 'label', and takes the 'retire' vehicles off the Forge palette. Variants (RJ's model): default = chin gun + side chainguns, grenade = chin gun + side grenade launchers, mp = side chainguns only, mp_gl = side grenade launchers only. Handling: normal = Falcon GL SPR's (host: up acceleration 14.6), fast = Fast Falcon GL SPR's. Seats (host: 'go with the 9 seats'): falcon_mp_spr's 9 = pilot, two door passengers, four boarding positions, and two more door seats for AI noncombatants only (Invalid For Player); 5 are a player's on every Falcon. Pilot seat: RJ's chin-gun Falcon (falcon_gl) flags its pilot Gunner + Prevents Weapon Stowing and his gunless ones (falcon_mp, falcon_mp_gl) don't, so chin-gun configurations take falcon_gl_spr's pilot flags and the others falcon_mp_spr's.
